goal: Buy the Canvas backpack in size M, quantity 2: add it to the cart, set the quantity to 2, and go to checkout. Leave any unrelated items already in the cart unchanged.

steps.instruction: Select size M for the Canvas backpack.
Add the Canvas backpack to the cart.
Set the Canvas backpack quantity to 2, leaving other quantities unchanged.
Save the cart quantity with Update.
Go to checkout with the Canvas backpack in size M, quantity 2.

verify: const expectedOrder = [...(initialCart || []), { product: 'Canvas backpack', size: 'M', quantity: 2 }];

const matchesExpectedOrder = cartItems => Array.isArray(cartItems) && cartItems.length === expectedOrder.length && cartItems.every((cartItem, index) => cartItem.product === expectedOrder[index].product && cartItem.size === expectedOrder[index].size && cartItem.quantity === expectedOrder[index].quantity);

location.hash === '#checkout' && document.title === 'Checkout · Local tasks' && document.querySelector('#checkout-summary h1')?.textContent === 'Checkout' && Array.isArray(initialCart) && matchesExpectedOrder(cart) && matchesExpectedOrder(order) && summary.length === expectedOrder.length && summary.every((text, index) => text === `${expectedOrder[index].product} · Size ${expectedOrder[index].size} · Quantity ${expectedOrder[index].quantity}`)
